source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: fusion and capture in accelerated autonomous rhythms.
implementation_basis: Existing authored conducted and ventricular electrode contours
invariants: Complete normal ventricular morphology replaces selected broad QRS/T
Independent P and unselected beats unchanged
Coincident electrical event and single mechanical event; RR grid unchanged
Fusion and capture cannot occupy same slot
Shared projection, raw data and within-beat recovery
limitations: Coincident fixed example only; no early capture or ectopic focus reset
No refractory/automaticity competition or pump calibration
